package wireless

config wifi-device 'radio0'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'platform/soc@0/c000000.wifi'
	option band '5g'
	option channel '52'
	option htmode 'VHT80'
	option country 'US'
	option cell_density '0'

config wifi-device 'radio1'
	option type 'mac80211'
	option path 'platform/soc@0/c000000.wifi+1'
	option band '2g'
	option channel 'auto'
	option htmode 'HT20'
	option country 'US'
	option disabled '0'
	option cell_density '0'

config wifi-iface 'wifinet3'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'sta'
	option network 'wwan'
	option ssid 'HomeUplink'
	option encryption 'psk2'
	option key 'REDACTED'
	option hidden '0'

config wifi-iface 'default_radio0'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'ap'
	option network 'lan'
	option disabled '1'
	option ssid 'TravelAP'
	option encryption 'psk2'
	option key 'REDACTED'

config wifi-iface 'default_radio1'
	option device 'radio1'
	option mode 'ap'
	option network 'lan'
	option disabled '0'
	option ssid 'TravelAP'
	option encryption 'psk2'
	option key 'REDACTED'

config wifi-iface 'sta0'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'sta'
	option network 'wwan'
	option ssid 'HomeNet'
	option key 'REDACTED'
	option encryption 'psk2'
	option hidden '0'
	option disabled '1'
	option macaddr '9e:6c:d4:9d:05:d0'

config wifi-iface 'sta1'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'sta'
	option network 'wwan'
	option ssid 'HotelA'
	option encryption 'none'
	option disabled '1'

config wifi-iface 'sta3'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'sta'
	option network 'wwan'
	option ssid 'TravoNoSuchNetwork2'
	option key 'REDACTED'
	option encryption 'psk2'
	option hidden '0'
	option disabled '1'

config wifi-iface 'sta2'
	option device 'radio0'
	option mode 'sta'
	option network 'wwan'
	option ssid 'HotelB'
	option encryption 'none'
	option hidden '0'
	option disabled '1'
